name: Debug RELOAD survivor bugs
description: Two passes. Pass 1 falsely concluded 'already fixed' (thin tests didn't trigger). Pass 2 proved BUG A: throttle-deferred RELOAD lets a pipelined command land in issuer con_recvQ; carried across but never reprocessed on a level-triggered engine with empty socket -> silent forever. Fix: schedule_recvq_process() arms con_proc on adoption for non-empty recvQ (s_bsd.c/s_bsd.h/hotreload_load.c). BUG B + ban_list were test bugs (HIS_LINKS non-oper, RPL_BANLIST param). Reviewed APPROVED (mechanism); merged a44e6cc. Owed: 1 regression test for BUG A.
